significance: A 15th-century Vijayanagara-period temple at Khanapur, about 15 km from Bidar on the Udgir road, dedicated to Khandoba in his Kannada form Mailar Mallanna.
story: Khandoba as Martanda Bhairava is said to have slain the demons Mallasura and Manikasura; the dying Malla gave up his white horse and asked that his spirit abide in every shrine of the god.
